audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing advice: nothing on the page carried a single number.
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes is a flat 3.5s at 450 range — it is not 'slow' or a rare window, so telling the player to kite 'his slow Q cooldown' misleads. The real windows are Path Maker at 14s falling to 10s, Footwork at 10s falling to 8s, and All Out at 120s falling to 80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the knock-up/wall effect to Ntofo Strikes ('Dodge his Q wall-knockups', 'Get walled by his Q'), says he has 'no gap-closer', and claims his base form 'has no tenacity to escape your Condemn'.
audit.why: Three separate errors. (1) Q's second stack fires a shockwave that PULLS enemies in; the knock-back and stun are Path Maker (W). (2) He has two dashes — Path Maker at 600 and Footwork at 525 — so 'no gap-closer' is plainly false. (3) Tenacity is not in Riot's text for either champion and must not be asserted. The genuinely decisive and unstated interaction: while All Out, Path Maker no longer knocks back or stuns, so his ult form trades away his only hard CC on you — that is why baiting All Out is right.
